sections.text: We Can Take Care of This!

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 4x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK and MATK by 160% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK buff limit by 80% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases MATK buff limit by 80% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 60 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 70 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000

[Super Serious Summer] Summer Takina or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
